Original source: upstream/liquid-glass.js (reference only; never imported or executed)
Source SHA256: f922ff104fa565cb51f2566155d30da1bfc40e126a30603f6760a50c9fdbdc2a
License SHA256: 30677f167845a6aa93e5f8a239a9de7d62f63f2b7fd351466e8fe25fe54ed0ec

Adaptation: src/ui/LiquidGlassTheme.tsx and src/ui/LiquidGlass.css
The smoothStep, rounded-rectangle signed distance and RG displacement-map
approach were adapted for the editor. Refraction follows a bounded edge-normal
vector in CSS pixels. Map resolution is capped; map values use a neutral 0.5 and
a complete signed displacement range. feImage has an explicit filter result.
Maps are cached by surface dimensions and corner radius, rebuilt on resize only.
The upstream console IIFE, global Shader/window.liquidGlass, movable overlay,
document mouse handlers and window resize handler were not incorporated.
React owns mounting and teardown, including observers, media-query listeners,
pending frame callbacks, filter definitions and decorative backdrop layers.
Text, icons, piano grid, notes and input targets are not filtered.
Reduced motion, reduced transparency, forced colors and unsupported filters
have static or solid-color fallbacks. This is a web approximation of glass
material, not an implementation of Apple's native platform APIs.
